PcCore.//Files: Nothing on disk is reachable unless it is listed here. Tokens: {Desktop} {Documents} {Downloads} {Pictures} {Music} {Videos} {UserProfile}. Absolute paths are also accepted.
PcCore.//Pairing: Pairing sessions and authentication challenges are short-lived and single-use.
PcCore.//Startup: Set Enabled to false to stop PC Core registering itself for sign-in start while you debug. Registration is a single HKCU Run value; see README.
